title: Ouroboros Tree of Doves
description: A surreal scene features a green serpent with a dog's head forming an ouroboros, its tongue out. A spiraling staircase ascends into a stylized tree whose canopy contains swirling blue and green patterns, with a purple dove and a white dove facing each other at the center. The night sky above contains stars, comets, and a constellation of a running dog.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork on black background showing a large green serpent with a friendly green dog head biting its tail in an ouroboros circle. A white spiral staircase winds up through the serpent's body into a large stylized tree. The tree canopy consists of swirling blue and green patterns. Two doves, one purple and one white, face each other at the center of the tree. Night sky above filled with stars, colorful comets, and a dog-shaped constellation.
